detailed_description:
The target video is live-action and cinematic, a misty field of red poppies at dusk under a pale overcast sky, rolling hills and hedgerows fading into haze, muted cold tones.
[Shot 1] A low ground-level tracking shot follows the armoured boots and trailing white cloak of <Subject 1> as she walks slowly through the tall grass and poppies, a sword hanging at her side, stepping past a dented steel helmet lying on the ground. The camera pedestals up slowly along her body, rising past the steel greaves, the white cloak and the scratched plate armour toward her shoulders.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.400, the shot cuts to a medium shot of <Subject 1>: in full silver plate armour and a torn white cloak, her auburn hair loose and damp, face smudged with dirt, she stops walking and stares into the distance, her breathing heavy, her expression shifting from grim resolve to deep exhaustion as her shoulders drop.
[Shot 3] At 00:06.400, the shot cuts to a wide static shot across the poppy field: <Subject 1> sinks slowly to her knees among the flowers, then lets herself fall back and lies flat on the ground, the white cloak spreading out beside her, poppies nodding in the breeze around her still form as the mist drifts across the hills.

overall_soundscape: A soft evening breeze through the grass, the heavy clink and scrape of armour with each step, a low weary exhale, then the rustle of the poppies as she lies down.

non_diegetic_music: A slow, mournful solo cello over a low string drone.
